name: Michigan · Wolverine Village double
derivedFrom: scaled from plan using the official Lifespace II furniture drawn on it (bed 80in x 40.5in, desk/dresser 36.5in x 24in; all four agree within 1%)

finishes.evidence: Official Wolverine Village room photo shows wood-look plank flooring, smooth painted walls and a smooth ceiling with a linear light (https://housing.umich.edu/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/SL-6-017-Wolverine-Village-Room-Doodles-01-R1.jpg). No finish text found.

confidence: medium — official to-scale layout diagram with no printed dimensions; scale comes from official furniture sizes drawn on it (agree within 1%), so room size (5.45 x 3.65 m, about 17'10" x 12'0") is measured to roughly ±3%; the sheet says 'Example Room Layout | Actual Room Layouts May Vary'; window heights and ceiling are unknown.
notes: Wolverine Village (Central Campus Residential Development) opened 2026; Building 1 houses 'first-year and returning students'. Older halls (Markley, Bursley, Mosher-Jordan) publish no plans; Housing's KB says 'Many of our double rooms are 11 feet by 12 feet' as an average and now points students to Roomie 3D models. Closets are open niches formed by 0.10 m-thick, 0.61 m-deep partition fins off the west wall (no doors drawn). The drawing shows each dresser partly under the foot of its bed (Lifespace II beds can sit on/over the dresser), so bed and dresser footprints overlap by design. Other official Lifespace II pieces: bookcase 36in W x 12in D x 30in H, desktop SmartBar 36 x 12 x 30; loft clearance 58in, half-loft 28.5in. Window sizes are measured on plan; sill/head heights not given.
